title: Neural communication for food retrieval and compositional code tests

criteria.effective_communication: Mean train-meaning success >=0.80, minimum seed >=0.65, mean normal-minus-shuffled success >=0.30, and every seed utility above independently trained silent same-seed control
criteria.reliable_food_retrieval: Mean heldout success >=0.95 and minimum seed >=0.90 with no hazard failures in complete deterministic evaluation
criteria.productive_compositional_code: Mean exact heldout four-fact decoding >=0.90, recombination exact >=0.90, single-token edit exact >=0.90, positional disentanglement >=0.80 and heldout unseen-message rate >=0.90
criteria.interpretation: A method with supplied modular roles or aligned slot routing supports induced compositional codes under those architectural assumptions, not unrestricted grammar emergence. No morphology or recursion claim.

extensions.novel_maze_execution: Freeze protocols and receiver beliefs, use public BFS on new obstacle maps, test cell execution separately from learned navigation
extensions.optional_tool: Freeze sequence_task, tied_slots_curriculum, and modular_curriculum protocols. Train a neural DIRECT INSPECT ASK policy from sampled rewards on training meanings, with 0.5 visibility, inspection costs 0.01 0.12 0.40 and request cost 0.02. No protocol retraining or selection on test outcomes.
